The latest from Jagex and RuneScape: updates, releases, community news and press. Stay up to date with what’s happening across our worlds. What Is Happening To The Oldschool Runescape Economy? How Raids 4 Is Crashing The Economy (OSRS) ...more One case of "hard price" inflation in RuneScape, was when Jagex raised the store price of chaos and death runes to be close to the typical player trading price, as the low prices aided auto-buying bots who camped in the stores and bought all the stock as it respawned.
